provenance.note: Verbatim evidence-destroying block: catch (Exception e) { success = false; } assigns only a literal to 'success', never references e, never rethrows, and a later 'if (!success) throw new FuzzerSecurityIssueLow(...)' conditions the alarm on that variable. boolean_swallow must fire and name the variable 'success'.

Synthetic negative (no bug provenance). The catch rethrows a wrapping exception that carries the caught exception as its cause, so the exception identity survives and there is no bare-flag swallow. boolean_swallow must be quiet (None).
